accepted.brand_shown: Ritalin (Novartis) among eight German methylphenidate cartons
accepted.market_evidence: German text ('Tabletten', 'Wirkstoff', 'Verschreibungspflichtig'); braille on several cartons; N1/N2 pack-size codes, which are German.
accepted.notes: Eight cartons of the same molecule from seven different makers, including the Ritalin Novartis box this folder is named for -- orange and white, braille, N1. The rest are Hexal, TAD, 1A Pharma, Equasym, Equasym Retard and two Medikinet. As a design reference this is worth more than one box: it shows seven houses solving the same label at the same strength, so what is convention and what is brand is separable.
